subject: Log as primary role (M) instead of child process (C) during startup (#1282)
reason: The change only moves the server.pid = getpid() assignment from initServer() to main() so that startup log lines show the primary role character 'M' instead of the child character 'C'. In a foreground (non-daemonized) server, which is the only way the fuzzer can run instances, server.pid receives the identical value as before, just earlier, so no command reply, replication, persistence or failover behaviour changes; the only readers of server.pid are the log role selector in serverLogRaw() and the module persistence subevent choice in startSaving(), and neither log text nor module events are o
